cues.text: 为什么上坡要换挡？先不记齿比。跟着金色链节走一圈：脚转动前链盘，链条牵动后飞轮，后轴再带着轮子前进。动力沿着这条路传过去。
靠近看。每颗齿都要接住对应的链节，间距不能随便画。链条绕过两个轮，再从另一侧回来，形成闭环。连续啮合，才有连续而可信的传动。
现在数前链盘的一圈。三十四颗齿，就拉过三十四个节距的链条。后面只有二十四颗齿，接完这些链节，就必须转过一圈多。速度关系从这里出来。
看下面的传动比。三十四除以二十四，大约是一点四二。脚转一圈，后轴转一点四二圈。这里是两轴教学传动架，帮助我们把这个比例直接看出来。
换成十二齿的小飞轮。脚还是按原来的节奏转，后轴却明显加快。链条每秒走过的长度没变，较小的轮子接完它，需要转更多圈。
快了，为什么会更费力？链条的拉力作用在更小的半径上，转动后轴的力矩就更小。想克服同样的阻力，你往往得在踏板上给出更大的力。
现在换成三十二齿。后轴慢下来，作用半径却变大了。用更低的前后齿比，你可以更轻松地转动负载，所以陡坡上往往会选更大的后飞轮。
把路抬高一点。除了滚动和空气阻力，你还得对抗沿坡向下的重力分量。看看所需踏板力怎么变。变速能调整你出力的方式，不能让坡度消失。
保持齿轮不动，慢一点踩，再快一点踩。链速和后轴转速一起变化。齿比决定两者的比例，踏频决定运行的节奏；这两个调节不能混为一谈。
省下的力并没有凭空变成能量。爬同样的高度，仍要增加重力势能。低挡通常需要踩更多圈；在相同踏频下，也会走得更慢。速度和力在互相交换。
看一下功率。模型算的是维持所选踏频需要多少输出，不代表骑车人一定做得到。它包含坡度、滚阻和风阻；换挡瞬间与拨链器动作，则没有在这里模拟。
再看这三次对比。上坡想轻一点，就降低前后齿比；平路想在相同踏频下快一点，就提高它。记住这条链路，比只背一句“大齿轮省力”更可靠。

cues.text: Why do we shift before a climb? Forget the formula for a moment. Follow the gold link: your foot turns the chainring, the chain pulls the rear sprocket, and the rear axle drives the wheel.

Move closer. Each tooth must meet a matching link, so their spacing is not arbitrary. The chain wraps both sprockets and returns along the other side. A continuous loop makes continuous transmission possible.

Count one turn of the chainring. Thirty-four teeth advance thirty-four chain pitches. The rear sprocket has twenty-four teeth, so receiving that chain takes more than one revolution. That is where the speed ratio comes from.

The ratio below is thirty-four divided by twenty-four, about one point four two. One pedal revolution produces that many rear revolutions. This two-axle teaching rig makes the relationship easy to see.
Switch to the twelve-tooth rear sprocket. The pedals keep their rhythm, but the rear axle speeds up. The chain advances at the same rate; the smaller sprocket must turn more times to receive it.
Why can that faster gear feel harder? Chain pull acts at a smaller radius, producing less torque at the rear axle. To overcome the same resistance, you generally need to push harder on the pedals.

Now choose thirty-two teeth. The rear axle slows, but the chain acts at a larger radius. The lower ratio makes the load easier to turn, which is why a larger rear sprocket often helps on a steep climb.

Raise the road. Alongside rolling resistance and drag, you must now overcome a larger downhill component of gravity. Watch the required pedal force rise. Gearing changes how you supply effort; it cannot remove the hill.

Keep the gears fixed and vary the pedaling rhythm. Chain speed and rear speed change together. The gear ratio sets their relationship; cadence sets the pace. Those are two different controls over the ride.

An easier push does not create energy. Climbing the same height still requires a gain in gravitational potential energy. A lower gear usually takes more pedal turns and, at the same cadence, moves you more slowly.

Check the power readout. The model calculates what maintaining your chosen cadence would require, not what a rider can necessarily deliver. It includes slope, rolling resistance and drag, while leaving out the transient shifting mechanism.

Compare the gears once more. Lower the front-to-rear ratio for an easier climb; raise it for more speed at a given cadence. Following the chain gives you a more reliable rule than simply calling one gear large or small.

cues.text: 打印机一响，纸上就有了字。可激光究竟照在哪里？先跟住这个橙色像素。我们打开外壳，看看它怎样从一条指令，变成纸上摸得到的碳粉。
中间这根圆筒叫感光鼓。上方是光路，下方才是纸张的通道。先分清这两条路：光负责安排图案，纸负责接走图案，它们并不直接碰面。
让鼓转起来。充电辊先把表面处理得一样，暂时没有任何图案。这里演示的是负电荷系统；橙色位置和旁边的空白位置，此刻还没有区别。
现在从上方看。激光扫过需要成像的位置，让那里的电位变得没那么负。图案已经写好了，只不过它还是电荷的差别。激光没有把纸烧黑。
显影辊带来细小的碳粉。注意橙色像素附近：碳粉在电场作用下留到曝光区域，旁边的空白区保持干净。刚才看不见的潜像，终于显出来了。
停近一点。别把这一幕简单理解成正负相吸。鼓面、碳粉和显影辊都有各自的电位；它们之间的电场，才决定碳粉往哪里走、在哪里留下。
纸到了。鼓面与纸张以配合的速度经过接触区，转印电场把碳粉带到纸上。橙色像素换了位置，却还是同一个图案。现在用手一擦，它还可能掉。
接下来经过这对辊子。碳粉里有树脂，受热会软化；再加上压力，就能与纸纤维牢固黏合。这才是定影。纸刚出来时温热，原因主要在这里。
纸已经走远，感光鼓的任务却还没结束。刮片清掉残粉，残余电荷也被消除。否则上一张图案就可能影响下一张。清洁完成，鼓面重新回到起点。
把镜头拉远，再连起来看一遍。电荷准备表面，光安排位置，碳粉让图案现身，电场把它交给纸，热和压力把它固定。每一步都给下一步创造条件。
再看齿轮和皮带。它们不是背景装饰：传动必须连续，鼓面与纸张不能各转各的。这里用教学剖面放慢过程，真实机器会把大量像素连续送过这些部件。
回到最初的问题：一束光怎么变成字？它先改变电荷，再借碳粉、纸张、热和压力完成接力。下次拿到一张打印纸，想想这个像素刚刚走完的路。

cues.text: A printer hums, and a page appears. But where does the laser actually shine? Follow the orange pixel as we open the machine and trace an instruction all the way to a mark on paper.
The central cylinder is the imaging drum. Light approaches from above; paper passes below. Keep those paths separate in your mind: the light arranges a pattern, and the paper collects it later.

As the drum turns, the charging roller prepares an even surface. There is no image yet. In this negative-charge teaching model, our orange position starts out electrically just like the surrounding blank area.
Look down along the optical path. The laser scans the intended image and makes those regions less negative. The pattern now exists as an electrical difference. Nothing has been burned into the paper.

The developer brings in tiny toner particles. Watch the orange pixel: the electric field guides toner onto the exposed region while the nearby background stays clear. The invisible image is becoming a visible one.

Let us stay close for a moment. This is more than a simple opposite-charges story. The drum, toner and developer have different electrical conditions; the resulting field determines where toner moves and where it stays.
Here comes the paper. Drum and sheet move through the transfer region at matching surface speeds. An electric field brings the toner across. Our pixel is on paper now, but the image is still fragile.

The sheet now passes between these rollers. Toner contains resin that softens with heat; pressure helps bond it to the paper fibers. This is fusing, and it explains much of the warmth of a freshly printed page.

The paper leaves, but the drum has another job. A blade removes leftover toner, and residual charge is cleared. Without that reset, one image could affect the next. The surface is ready for another cycle.

Pull back and connect the sequence. Charge prepares the surface, light selects the positions, toner reveals the image, a field transfers it, and heat and pressure make it lasting. Each stage prepares the next.

Notice the gears and belt. They coordinate motion rather than merely decorate the machine. Drum and paper cannot move independently. This cutaway slows the process down; a real printer carries many pixels through it continuously.
So how does light become a letter? It first changes charge, then hands the job to toner, paper, heat and pressure. The next time you collect a print, think of the journey hidden inside each dot.

cues.text: 冰箱里面冷，背后却常常发热。它不是在制造一种叫“冷”的东西，而是在把热搬出去。跟住管路里的亮点，我们从一圈制冷循环，找到这笔能量的去向。
先看完整管路。制冷剂流过四个主要环节，再回到起点。正常工作时，它反复使用，不会像燃料一样每转一圈就消耗掉。改变的是压力、温度和液汽状态。
回来的蒸气压力低。压缩机消耗电能，对蒸气做功，让它升压、升温。为什么要先变热？因为要向房间放热，制冷剂得比周围空气更热才行。
沿着热色管路走。制冷剂把热交给房间，自己逐渐冷凝成液体。这里不仅放出了从箱内搬来的热，还要放出压缩机输入的那份能量。
注意管路不是到处都处于同一种压力。高压侧适合向室内放热，低压侧则能在更低温度下吸热。正是这种压力安排，让热可以从冷的箱内被搬到暖的房间。
液体接着经过狭窄的毛细管。压力下降，一部分液体迅速闪蒸，出口成为低温的液汽混合物。这里没有活塞在做有用的机械功，也不是把冷气从管子里挤出来。
现在来到箱内的蒸发器。剩下的液体继续沸腾，需要吸收能量。这份能量来自食物和箱内空气，于是它们冷下来。低压蒸气随后回到压缩机，循环闭合。
看这三个数。假设输入八十瓦电功，制冷系数是二点五，就能搬走两百瓦的热，而房间得到两百八十瓦。热流可以大于电功，因为机器还搬运了已有的热。
把制冷系数调高，看看同样的输入能搬走多少热。超过一不违背能量守恒，因为分子是搬运的热量，分母是你额外付出的功。这和把电直接变热的效率不是一回事。
那么一直开着冰箱门，能给房间降温吗？箱内吸走的热也来自这个房间，背后又把它连同电功一起放回来。把整个房间作为系统，净增加的是压缩机输入的能量。
再跟亮点走一圈：先做功升压，再向外放热；接着降压，最后在箱内吸热。颜色表示教学状态，粒子的速度并不代表真实分子速度，实际管路也会因机型变化。
下次看到冰箱或空调，别只盯着冷的一面。找找它从哪里吸热，向哪里放热，又从哪里获得做功的能量。把这三条路径连起来，制冷的原理就清楚了。

cues.text: The inside is cold, but the back can feel warm. A refrigerator does not manufacture a substance called cold; it moves heat. Follow the bright marker around the circuit to see where that energy goes.

Start with the entire pipe circuit. Refrigerant passes through four main stages and returns to the beginning. During normal operation it is reused rather than burned up. Its pressure, temperature and liquid-vapor state change along the way.

Returning vapor is at low pressure. The compressor uses electrical energy to raise its pressure and temperature. Why make it hot first? To release heat into the room, the refrigerant must be hotter than the surrounding air.

Follow the warm-colored pipe. Refrigerant releases heat to the room and gradually condenses into liquid. That rejected heat includes both what was removed from the interior and the energy supplied by the compressor.

The loop does not have one pressure everywhere. The high-pressure side releases heat to the room; the low-pressure side can absorb heat at a much lower temperature. This pressure arrangement makes the heat-moving cycle possible.

Liquid passes through a narrow capillary. The pressure drops, and some liquid flashes into vapor, leaving a cold mixture. This restriction does not produce useful shaft work, and it does not squeeze a supply of cold air into existence.

At the evaporator inside the cabinet, the remaining liquid boils. That change needs energy, supplied by the food and air inside, so they cool down. Low-pressure vapor then returns to the compressor, completing the loop.

Read the three numbers. With eighty watts of input and a coefficient of performance of two point five, two hundred watts are removed inside and two hundred eighty released outside. The machine moves existing heat as well as consuming electricity.

Increase the coefficient and watch how much heat the same input can move. A value above one does not violate conservation: the numerator is transported heat, while the denominator is added work. It is not an energy-creation efficiency.

Could leaving the door open cool the room? The absorbed heat would now come from that same room, then return at the back along with compressor work. For the room as a whole, the electrical input becomes a net heat gain.

Follow the marker once more: add work and pressure, reject heat, reduce pressure, then absorb heat inside. Colors illustrate the states, not literal molecular behavior. Real pipe layouts and operating conditions vary between refrigerators.

The next time you see a refrigerator or air conditioner, look beyond the cold side. Find where heat is absorbed, where it is rejected, and where work enters. Connect those three paths, and the mechanism becomes much clearer.

cues.text: 耳机明明多放了一段声音，为什么反而安静？先看蓝色波形。它表示耳边空气压力的起伏，不是空气沿着这条曲线跑。声音抵达同一点时，压力变化会相加。
让橙色波形加入，并且和蓝色保持同一个节奏。波峰遇到波峰，波谷遇到波谷，下方的结果就更大了。所以“多放一个声音”本身，并不会带来降噪。
把橙色波形慢慢移开。它们的频率没变，只是到达波峰的时刻不同了。这种相对错位叫相位差。留意下面的曲线，它会随着相位连续变化。
现在让蓝色的波峰正对橙色的波谷。一个增加压力，另一个同样多地降低压力，相加恰好为零。下面变平了：在这个理想位置，这个频率被抵消了。
保持反相，但把橙色波形缩小。蓝色的起伏没有被完全补上，残余又出现了。降噪需要的不只是“反着放”，还要把抵消声的幅度调到合适大小。
让橙色逐渐追上蓝色，看看残余怎样减小。耳机也需要估计耳边实际剩下多少声音，再调整输出。真实声场会变化，这不是设置一次就永远准确的关系。
如果处理和传播让抵消声晚到了呢？这里增加两毫秒。原本对好的波峰与波谷重新错开，抵消开始变差。很短的延迟，也可能在波的周期里占据很大比例。
保持同样的延迟，再提高频率。波峰更密，相同的时间差就跨过更多周期比例。效果会随频率起伏，因此某个频率调好了，不等于所有声音都一起消失。
我们一直在看同一个位置。如果换个位置，两种声音走过的距离就变了，相位关系也可能改变。所以耳机的主动降噪主要照顾耳边区域，并不会让整个房间同时静音。
真实耳机会用麦克风采集信息，让控制器估计合适的输出，再由扬声器播放。我们画出的两道正弦波只是最清楚的一小部分，完整控制还要面对佩戴变化和复杂噪声。
把频率降回去，并消除额外延迟。稳定低频的周期比较长，更适合看清这种补偿；突发或复杂高频声音则更难处理。耳罩本身的被动隔音，也在贡献安静。
最后再对齐一次。想判断为什么降噪变差，就依次看幅度、相位和延迟。波形相加没有魔法；真正困难的是，让正确的波在正确的时刻，到达正确的位置。

cues.text: How can a headphone add sound and make things quieter? Start with the blue waveform: it shows pressure varying at your ear, not air traveling along a drawn curve. At one point, pressure changes add together.
Add the orange wave in step with the blue one. Peak meets peak and trough meets trough, so the result below grows. Merely adding another sound does not produce noise cancellation; its timing matters.

Slide the orange waveform gradually. Its frequency stays the same, but its peaks arrive at different moments. That relative shift is phase difference. Watch the lower curve respond continuously as the timing changes.
Align a blue peak with an orange trough. One raises pressure by exactly as much as the other lowers it. Their sum is zero. At this idealized listening point, this particular frequency is canceled.

Keep the opposite phase but reduce the orange amplitude. It no longer offsets the full blue wave, so a residual returns. Cancellation requires both suitable timing and a suitable amplitude, not just an inverted waveform.

Bring the orange amplitude back toward the blue one and watch the residual shrink. Headphones must also estimate what remains near the ear and adjust their output. In a changing sound field, one fixed setting is not enough.

What if processing and propagation make the cancellation sound arrive late? Add two milliseconds here. Peaks and troughs drift out of alignment, and cancellation worsens. A tiny delay can occupy a substantial fraction of a wave cycle.

Keep the delay and raise the frequency. The peaks are closer together, so the same time difference represents more phase rotation. The result varies with frequency; tuning one tone does not remove every sound at once.

We have been observing one location. Move elsewhere and the two sounds travel different distances, changing their phase relationship. Headphone cancellation is designed around the ear; it does not silence an entire room at once.

A real headphone collects microphone signals, estimates an appropriate response and drives its speakers continuously. Our two sine waves isolate the clearest part of the idea. The full controller must also handle fit changes and complicated noise.

Return to the lower frequency and remove the extra delay. Its longer, steadier cycle makes the compensation easier to understand. Sudden and complex high-frequency sounds are harder, while the earcups also provide passive isolation.

Align the waves one last time. If cancellation deteriorates, consider amplitude, phase and delay together. Superposition is straightforward; the difficult part is delivering the right wave at the right place and the right moment.

cues.text: 地图上的蓝点不是卫星拍到你的照片。卫星广播自己的位置和时间信息，手机估计信号走了多久，再把时间换成距离。问题于是变成：哪些位置符合这些距离？
先把世界压成平面。知道离第一颗卫星多远，只能画出一个圆。圆上的每个点都满足这个距离，所以一个信号不能单独告诉你在圆的哪一边。
加入第二个距离。两个圆通常会留下两个交点。我们已经排除了很多位置，但仍然有两个候选答案。只挑一个看起来顺眼的点，不算完成定位。
第三个圆来了。只有一个候选点同时落在它上面，另一个被排除了。你看到的是距离约束共同确定位置，这种方法叫测距定位，不是靠测三个方向的角度。
怎么知道这个点算得对？把它到每个信号源的距离重新算一遍，再和观测值比较。差值叫残差。真实定位里测量有误差，通常需要寻找整体最符合观测的解。
把平面打开，进入立体世界。一个距离现在对应一个球面，两个球面的交线通常是圆。定位多了高度这个未知量，二维图里的三圆结论不能原样照搬过来。
还有一个麻烦：手机的时钟不像卫星钟那样精确。如果它统一偏了一点，计算出来的多条距离都会一起偏。球面于是对不上，问题并不一定出在你的位置。
现在数未知量：东西、南北、高度，再加接收机时钟偏差，一共四个。足够独立的卫星观测，才能把它们一起解出来。这也是常说至少需要四颗卫星的原因。
看这些球面一起收回来。模型正在从观测距离里扣除共同的时钟偏差，而不是随便移动某一颗卫星。调整到合适的位置和偏差后，多条约束就重新一致了。
卫星并不是越多就一定越好，站位也很重要。如果都挤在相近方向，距离的一点误差就可能对应很大的位置变化。分布更展开，通常能提供更独立的几何约束。
真实信号还会穿过大气、被建筑反射，卫星轨道信息也存在误差。这里的距离和时钟是缩放后的教学模型，没有把这些修正全部搬进来，所以不能当作真实定位器。
回到地图上的蓝点。它背后是一组不断更新的距离、时钟和几何约束。记住从一个圆，到多个球面，再到共同校正时钟的过程，你就看到了定位计算的骨架。

cues.text: The blue dot is not a satellite photograph of you. Satellites broadcast position and timing information. Your receiver estimates travel time, converts it into distance, then asks which location is consistent with those measurements.

Flatten the world to a plane first. One known distance gives us a circle. Every point on that circle satisfies the measurement, so one signal cannot tell us which side of the circle contains the receiver.

Add a second distance. The circles generally intersect at two points. Most possible locations disappear, but two candidates remain. Choosing whichever looks convenient would not be a valid position fix; we need more information.

Here comes the third circle. Only one candidate also satisfies this distance, so the other disappears. Position is determined by combining range constraints. We are measuring distances here, not intersecting three measured angles.

How do we check that dot? Recalculate its distance to every source and compare those values with the measurements. The differences are residuals. Real measurements contain errors, so receivers generally seek a solution that best fits them together.

Open the plane into three dimensions. One range now defines a sphere, and two spheres usually intersect in a circle. Height adds another unknown, so the three-circle conclusion from our flat diagram cannot simply be carried over unchanged.

There is another unknown: the receiver clock is not as precise as the satellite clocks. A shared timing offset biases several measured ranges together. The spheres then fail to meet properly, even if the receiver has not moved.

Count the unknowns: three position coordinates and one receiver clock offset. We need enough independent satellite observations to estimate them together. That is the reason a basic three-dimensional fix is commonly described as requiring at least four satellites.

Watch the spheres adjust together. The model subtracts a shared clock bias from the observed ranges rather than arbitrarily moving one satellite. With a suitable position and offset, the separate constraints become consistent again.

Satellite count is not the whole story; geometry matters too. When sources cluster in similar directions, small range errors can imply large position changes. A wider spread generally supplies more independent constraints on the solution.

Real signals travel through the atmosphere, may reflect from buildings, and rely on imperfect orbit information. Our scaled distance-and-clock model leaves out many of those corrections. It explains the geometry rather than serving as an actual navigation receiver.

Return to that blue dot. Behind it sits a continually updated set of ranges, timing estimates and geometric constraints. From one circle to several spheres and a shared clock correction, you have now seen the basic structure of the calculation.

cues.text: 一张照片变小以后，究竟丢了什么？先只看这六十四个像素。我们不拿整张图片做黑箱压缩，而是把一小块拆开，再亲眼看它怎样重建回来。
同一块图像，不一定只能用六十四个亮度值表示。也可以问：它包含多少整体亮度、多少横向变化、多少纵向变化？这些明暗图案组合起来，仍能描述原来的像素。
看中间轮流出现的条纹。粗条纹变化慢，细条纹变化快；方向不同，描述的结构也不同。离散余弦变换，就是计算原图需要每种图案多少份。
先只留第一项。右边变成一片均匀的灰，因为这一项描述整块的平均亮度。它能告诉你总体偏亮还是偏暗，却不能告诉你边缘在哪里。
把变化比较慢的图案加回来。大范围的明暗分布开始出现，轮廓也逐渐可辨。低频不是“重要像素的位置”，而是跨越整块图像的一种变化方式。
再加入变化更快的图案。边缘变清楚，细小起伏也回来了。如果所有系数都精确保留，再做逆变换，就能恢复原来的数值，除了有限计算精度带来的误差。
到这里，我们主要换了一种记法，并没有凭空减少六十四个数。真正的取舍从量化开始：不再精确保存每个系数，而是按规定步长取整，让一些细微差别合并。
把质量向下调，看看系数和重建图。量化更粗，一些小系数被舍成零。需要描述的信息更简单了，但原来不同的细节也被合并，逆变换不能把它们猜回来。
看误差读数，再看边缘。它衡量这块图重建后偏离原像素多少，并不等于人眼对整张照片的评分。某些图案容易压，尖锐边缘和细纹理往往更敏感。
彩色照片还有颜色通道。常见编码会保留较多亮度细节，降低部分颜色分辨率，叫色度降采样。我们眼前实算的是亮度块，所以不能把它当成已经演示了所有彩色编码步骤。
系数产生很多零以后，还可以按规定顺序组织，再用游程和熵编码描述重复模式。这一步把统计规律变成更短的比特序列。但这里没有输出完整文件，非零系数数目也不是实际文件大小。
最后把质量拉回来。细节恢复，系数也更丰富了。记住这三步：变换找到结构，量化决定舍弃多少精度，重建把取舍重新变成像素。你现在能看见压缩到底在牺牲什么。

cues.text: When a photograph gets smaller, what is actually lost? Start with these sixty-four pixels. Instead of treating a whole image as a compression black box, we will take one small block apart and rebuild it in front of you.

A block need not be described only as sixty-four brightness values. We can instead measure its overall brightness and its horizontal and vertical variations. A mixture of those patterns can still represent the original pixels.

Watch the patterns in the middle. Broad stripes vary slowly; narrow stripes vary quickly, and different directions describe different structure. The discrete cosine transform calculates how much of each pattern the original block needs.

Keep only the first coefficient. The reconstruction becomes a uniform gray because this term describes average brightness across the block. It tells us whether the block is broadly light or dark, but cannot locate an edge.

Add the slowly varying patterns. Broad light and dark regions return, and the outline becomes recognizable. A low-frequency coefficient is not the location of an important pixel; it describes a pattern extending across the whole block.

Now add faster variations. Edges sharpen and finer details return. If every coefficient is preserved precisely, the inverse transform can recover the original values, apart from limited numerical precision. The transform itself is not the main source of loss.

So far we have mainly changed the notation, not magically removed sixty-four numbers. The tradeoff begins with quantization: coefficients are rounded to specified steps, merging small differences that would otherwise require more precise values.

Lower the quality setting and compare the coefficients with the reconstruction. Coarser rounding turns small coefficients into zeros. The description becomes simpler, but distinct details merge. The inverse transform cannot know which lost values were originally present.

Read the error value, then inspect the edge. It measures how far this reconstructed block differs from its original pixels; it is not a complete perceptual score for a photograph. Sharp edges and fine textures can be especially sensitive.

Color photographs introduce additional channels. Common encoders retain more brightness detail while reducing some color resolution through chroma subsampling. Our live calculation is a luminance block, so it does not claim to perform every stage of color encoding.

Once many coefficients are zero, ordering and entropy coding can describe runs and recurring patterns compactly. That turns statistical regularity into fewer bits. We do not output a complete image file here, so a nonzero-coefficient count is not a file size.

Bring quality back up. Detail returns and the coefficients become richer. Remember the three steps: transform reveals structure, quantization chooses how much precision to discard, and reconstruction turns that choice back into pixels you can inspect.

cues.text: 输入“猫爱吃”，模型下一步会选什么？先看还没训练过的版本。它也能输出概率，但这些数主要来自初始权重，还没有从例子中学会猫和鱼之间的关系。
这台小模型先把文字变成编号。为了让每一步都能看清，我们只用了九个字符；真实模型通常会把文本切成更复杂的词元。编号不是含义，它只是进入计算的入口。
看这张嵌入矩阵。每个词元对应一组数，也就是向量。训练会改变这些数，让它们在后续计算中变得有用。它不是我们预先给“猫”写好的一份百科解释。
“猫吃鱼”和“鱼吃猫”用到的字相近，意思却不同。模型不能只收一袋没有顺序的字。这个教学网络把位置信息也加入表示，再把它们送入注意力计算。
看注意力图里的一行。它显示当前这个位置怎样分配对上下文的权重，再把信息加权汇集起来。亮一点表示权重较大；它并不等同于人类在认真思考某个词。
注意图里被挡住的未来位置。练习预测下一个字时，模型不能提前看到答案。因果遮罩就是这道限制：每个位置只能利用允许的历史上下文，否则训练题就被泄题了。
现在拿预测对照训练答案。目标是“鱼”，如果模型给它的概率很低，这次损失就比较大。损失是一个可计算的评价值，让“这次猜得不好”变成可以优化的数学问题。
误差怎样变成学习？从损失往回算，得到各个权重的梯度。它回答的是：在当前附近，这个数稍微变一点，损失倾向于怎样变？它不是直接把正确答案塞进某一个格子。
优化器根据梯度调整权重，再继续看训练样本。留意损失曲线和概率一起变化。这些数来自真正运行的小网络，不是预先画好的下降曲线；个别步骤也不保证每次都下降。
多练习几轮，再看“鱼”的概率。模型开始反映这份小语料里的规律。但它只有很小的词表和结构，这个结果只证明教学任务上的变化，不能拿来宣称已经拥有通用语言能力。
现在切到生成。把训练停下来，锁住权重，再给它“猫爱吃”。这次只向前计算下一字的分布，不对照训练答案，也不做刚才那种反向更新。
从概率分布里选一个词元，接到输入后面。这里为了演示可复现，先选择概率最高的一项。真实系统也可以采样；选法影响结果，但不是在这一步重新训练权重。
把刚生成的字放回去，再预测下一字。句子就是这样逐步长出来的。每一步的上下文会变，概率也可能变，但权重仍然不动。这和训练阶段最关键的区别，就在这里。
回头看完整链路：词元进入向量，注意力汇集上下文，输出概率；训练再算损失、求梯度、更新权重。生成则选择词元、追加上下文、继续预测。把这两条过程分清，很多困惑就解开了。

cues.text: Give the model the phrase “cat likes eating.” What comes next? Even this untrained version produces probabilities, but they mostly reflect its initial weights. It has not yet learned the relationship between cats and fish from examples.

Our tiny model first turns text into identifiers. We use only nine characters so every step stays visible; production systems generally tokenize text differently. An identifier is not meaning itself, but an entry point into the calculation.

Look at the embedding matrix. Each token maps to a vector, a set of numbers that training can change. Those numbers become useful in later computation; they are not a prewritten encyclopedia definition of the word cat.

“Cat eats fish” and “fish eats cat” contain similar tokens but mean different things. The model cannot treat text as an unordered bag. This teaching network includes position information before sending the representations into attention.

Read one row of the attention map. It shows how a position weights available context and combines that information. Brighter cells mean larger weights. That numerical weighting should not be confused with a person consciously thinking about a word.

Notice the blocked future positions. A model learning next-token prediction must not see the answer ahead of time. The causal mask enforces that restriction, limiting each position to permitted earlier context rather than leaking future tokens into the exercise.

Compare the prediction with the training target, fish. A low probability for that target produces a larger loss. This calculable score turns “that prediction was poor” into a mathematical objective that the learning process can try to reduce.

How does an error become learning? Work backward from the loss to obtain gradients. Each asks how the loss would change with a small nearby change to a weight. This does not simply place the correct answer into one particular cell.

The optimizer adjusts the weights, then processes more training examples. Watch loss and probabilities change together. These values come from the working small network, not a prerecorded falling curve, and individual updates are not guaranteed to improve every prediction.

After more training, inspect the probability of fish. The model begins reflecting patterns in this tiny dataset. Its vocabulary and structure are deliberately small; success here demonstrates the mechanism, not general language understanding or the capabilities of a production model.

Now stop training and switch to generation. Hold the weights fixed and supply the same context. We only run forward to obtain a next-token distribution; we do not compare against a training target or perform a backward update.

Select a token from the distribution and append it to the context. For a reproducible demonstration, we choose the highest-probability option. Real systems may sample instead. That choice changes the output without retraining the weights at this step.

Feed the newly extended context through the same network and predict again. The sequence grows one token at a time. Context and probabilities change from step to step, while the weights stay fixed—the crucial distinction from training.

Trace the whole chain: tokens become vectors, attention combines context, and the network produces probabilities. Training adds loss, gradients and weight updates. Generation instead selects a token, extends context and predicts again. Keeping those two processes separate resolves many common confusions.

cues.text: 四维究竟多了什么？先别急着想一个奇怪的立体。维度最基本的意思，是确定位置需要几个独立坐标。我们从一条线开始，让每一个新增方向都实际出现。
线上的位置用一个数就能描述。现在把整条线沿另一个独立方向移动，它扫出了正方形。位置需要两个数：沿原方向走多少，再沿新方向走多少。
再把正方形抬出原来的平面。你熟悉的立方体出现了。它不是把正方形画得更大，而是增加了一个原来两个方向都无法替代的方向：高度。
其实你现在也没直接看到一个三维物体。屏幕只有二维，深度通过投影、遮挡和运动表达出来。我们早就习惯用低维图像理解高维结构，只是平时没有特别注意。
照着刚才的构造再来一次：沿第四个独立方向移动立方体，对应顶点连接起来，得到超立方体。这个方向不能简单画成屏幕上的另一根普通空间轴，所以我们看它的投影。
看对应的连接关系。四维超立方体有十六个顶点、三十二条边。图里像是一个盒子套另一个盒子，这只是投影的外观，并不说明四维里真的有一个小盒子藏在大盒子中间。
让它在涉及第四维的平面里旋转。边的投影长度和前后关系都在变，但哪些顶点相连并没有变。盯住同一条边，你会更容易区分结构本身和我们观看它的方式。
投影和切片又有什么区别？现在用一个球来说明。平面穿过球，只留下它们相交的圆。切片没有把整个球都压到纸上，它只显示这个高度上真正切到的部分。
把平面慢慢扫过去。圆先出现、变大，经过中心后再缩小，最后消失。低维观察者只看到这些变化的圆，也可以由一连串切片，推断背后有一个更高维的物体。
换个意思看维度。这些水果可以用质量、甜度、含水量描述，每个独立特征都能占一个坐标。这里的第四维不一定是空间方向；它也可以只是第四种用于比较对象的属性。
把纵轴从甜度换成含水量。点的位置变了，水果本身却没变。我们只是挑选了不同的两个特征来展示。高维数据可视化的许多方法，都在处理这种展示与信息保留之间的取舍。
最后回看超立方体。维度说的是独立坐标，投影给我们一个低维视图，切片则取出某个截面。分清这三个概念，就不必把四维想成一个神秘、无法接近的形状。

cues.text: What does a fourth dimension add? Start without imagining an exotic solid. Dimension counts the independent coordinates needed to locate a point. Begin with a line, and let each new direction appear one step at a time.

One number locates a point on a line. Move that whole segment in an independent direction and it sweeps out a square. A point now needs two numbers: one along the original direction and one along the new one.

Lift the square out of its plane and a familiar cube appears. This is not merely a larger square. It introduces a direction that neither of the original two can replace: height, requiring a third coordinate.

You are not directly viewing a three-dimensional object even now. The screen is flat; projection, occlusion and motion communicate depth. We already use lower-dimensional images to understand higher-dimensional structures, often without noticing the translation.

Repeat the construction: move a cube along a fourth independent direction and connect corresponding vertices. The result is a tesseract. That direction cannot be drawn as another ordinary spatial axis on the screen, so we study a projection.

Look at corresponding connections: a tesseract has sixteen vertices and thirty-two edges. The picture resembles one box inside another, but that is a projection effect. It does not mean a physically smaller box sits inside a larger one in four dimensions.

Rotate in a plane involving the fourth coordinate. Projected edge lengths and apparent depth change, but the connections remain the same. Follow one edge to distinguish the underlying structure from the particular view used to display it.

How is a slice different from a projection? Use a sphere to see it. A plane cuts through the sphere and reveals their circular intersection. It does not flatten the whole sphere; it keeps only the part actually touched by that plane.

Sweep the plane through. A circle appears, grows, reaches its largest size at the center, then shrinks and disappears. An observer seeing only these circles could use their sequence to infer a higher-dimensional object behind them.

Now consider another meaning of dimension. Fruit can be described by mass, sweetness and water content, each supplying a feature coordinate. A fourth dimension need not be a direction in physical space; it may simply be another attribute used for comparison.

Switch the vertical axis from sweetness to water content. The points move, but the fruit has not changed; we selected a different pair of attributes. Many high-dimensional visualizations make related tradeoffs about which information a view preserves.

Return to the tesseract. Dimension concerns independent coordinates; projection provides a lower-dimensional view; slicing selects an intersection. Keeping those ideas distinct lets you reason about four dimensions without treating them as a mysterious, inaccessible shape.

cues.text: 把摆球拉到一边，先停住。它还没有速度，但已经比最低点高。松手后，这一点高度开始变成运动。我们跟完整个来回，看看能量和时间各自怎么变化。

看它经过中间。位置最低的时候，势能条变短，动能条变长。它不会在这里停下，因为刚才加速积累的速度还在，惯性带着它继续向另一边走。
上升时，速度又变回高度。到最远处，摆球短暂静止，却没有失去全部能量；能量主要存回了势能。随后重力让它返回，交换过程再来一遍。

沿着虚线看过去：地球始终在看同一颗月球。它走到太阳这一侧时，亮面大多背对我们；走到另一侧，亮面便转向我们。轨道图把距离压缩了，但旁边月面上的每一道明暗变化，都用的是同一个太阳方向。
再慢慢走完一轮。细月牙变宽，经过上弦、盈凸，来到满月附近；随后亮区缩小，经过下弦，回到新月。下面的小月亮只是沿途的观察点，变化本身是连续的。明暗交界弯曲，是因为我们在看一个球面。
那月食又是什么？先看满月从地球影子上方经过，虽然很圆，却没有进入影子。现在只改变轨道的对齐方向，让它穿过本影，月面才暗下来。这里是一组受控对照。普通盈亏来自视角；月食还需要太阳、地球和月球特别对齐。
盯住金色标记。月球绕地球走，标记也跟着转，却始终指向地球。这就是同步自转：相对远处恒星，一圈公转配一圈自转。所以我们总看到大致相同的一面。另一面叫远侧，绝不是永远黑暗；它也会轮流迎来白天。

cues.text: Follow the copper first. The left winding connects to the AC source; the right circuit is open. The wires never meet. Now watch the green arrows reverse around the closed core. Primary excitation establishes a changing field that also links the secondary. Even with no load current, a voltage can appear at its terminals.

These two traces share the same time axis. Green is magnetic flux; copper is secondary voltage. Pause at the green crest. There is plenty of flux, but its slope is zero, so the voltage is zero too. Move to the flux zero crossing: change is fastest there. Faraday’s law follows the slope, not simply the field strength.

Keep the primary at twenty-four turns and four volts RMS. With twelve secondary turns, the output is two volts. Replace that winding with twenty-four turns: four volts. Forty-eight turns gives eight. Notice that the green trace has not grown. The higher voltage comes from adding more turns around the same changing flux, rather than strengthening the field.

Close the switch and give the secondary voltage a path through the resistor. Load current appears, and primary current increases as well. The secondary’s magnetic effect opposes the original change; extra primary current balances it. With source voltage and frequency fixed, the flux stays the same in this lossless model. The source is now delivering power to a load.

For this comparison, omit excitation current and all losses. Start with two volts at the output. Now use eight volts and increase the load resistance so the power stays equal. Four times the voltage needs one quarter of the output current. The power ribbon remains unchanged. This is an equal-power comparison; leaving resistance fixed would give a different result.

Try a different experiment. Leave the secondary open and switch on DC through a current-limiting resistor. At first, current and flux build, creating a brief secondary voltage. As the green curve flattens, that voltage fades towards zero. A static field remains, but it cannot sustain induction. This linear, current-limited example does not model saturation in a real transformer.

Back on AC, look at the thin core laminations. A changing field can drive eddy currents in conducting iron; insulation between sheets restricts those loops. Hysteresis and copper resistance still cause loss. Watch the open circuit, then the loaded circuit. Core loss remains even without output power, while copper loss changes with current. The ribbon accounts for each destination separately.

Finally, hold the turns and input voltage fixed, and raise frequency from fifty to one hundred hertz. Each cycle takes half as long, so half the flux swing produces the same secondary voltage. Follow the chain once more: the source maintains changing flux, each turn contributes induced voltage, and a connected load draws current. Pause and scrub to line up each relationship.

现在换一种安排。编号一往前走，空出的取指工位马上迎来编号二。再过一拍，第三条也进来了。跟住这些编号：同一拍里，几条指令占着不同工位。编号会标出每条指令正走到哪一步。它们同时工作，只是各做不同的一步。
让同一份程序同时跑两次：上面允许重叠，下面做完一条才开始下一条。留意完成的编号，上面出现得更密。可第一条从开始到结束，两边都用了五拍。流水线提高的是吞吐量。完整程序里的空位从哪里来？接下来把它们放慢看。
先关掉数据前递。编号三要把前两条得到的四和七相加，可寄存器里的值还没更新。它不能拿旧值凑答案，只能留在译码级等待。后面的取指也停住，前面的指令继续写回。这个空位是为了保证正确，不是丢失了一条指令。
回到同一段程序，这次打开前递。看指向编号三的两条路：四来自写回这一端，七来自访存之前已经锁存的运算结果。执行级直接收到它们，算出十一。这时结果寄存器还没有变成十一。结果已算出，和结果已写回，是两个时刻。
再看编号四，它从内存读取数据。执行级只算出了地址，还没有拿到地址里的十一。紧跟着的编号五马上就要用它，前递也不能传来尚未读出的数。因此等一拍，让访存完成。下一拍，十一沿前递路径送到执行级，计算才接上。
编号六比较两个十一，决定跳到编号九。可是决定出来以前，取指已经沿着原来的顺序往前走了。把编号七和八划掉：它们虽然被取来，却不能写寄存器，更不能把错误结果写进内存。重新从目标取指，空出的两个位置，就是这次分支的代价。
最后重新跑完整份程序，把结果核对上。两边完成的都是八条有效指令，寄存器和内存也完全一致。流水线用了十五拍：八条指令，加上四拍填充排空、一拍数据等待和两个分支空位。逐条执行用了四十拍。得到同一个答案，安排工作的方式改变了完成时间。

cues.text: Follow instruction one. Fetch brings it in; decode identifies the operation. Execute adds zero and four. It passes the memory stage, then writes four into a register. This addition needs no memory access, but still passes that station. Our teaching processor has five stages, each taking one cycle.

Now change the schedule. As instruction one moves on, instruction two uses the fetch station it has left behind. A cycle later, the third arrives. Follow the instruction IDs. In one cycle, several instructions occupy different stations. Each ID shows which step its instruction has reached. They work at the same time, on different steps.

Run the same program both ways. The upper schedule overlaps instructions; the lower finishes one before starting another. Completed IDs arrive closer together above. Yet instruction one still takes five cycles in both schedules. The improvement is throughput. Those gaps in the overlapping schedule have causes too. Let us slow down and inspect them.

Turn forwarding off. Instruction three needs the four and seven produced by the first two instructions, but the register values are not ready. It must wait in decode instead of using stale inputs. Fetch waits too, while older instructions continue toward writeback. The empty slot protects correctness; no instruction has been lost.

Replay that same passage with forwarding enabled. Two routes reach instruction three: four from the writeback side, and seven from an arithmetic result already latched before memory. Execute can add them immediately. The destination register still has not become eleven. Computing a result and writing it back happen at different times.

Instruction four loads a value from memory. Execute has calculated its address, but has not yet obtained the eleven stored there. Instruction five needs that value immediately. Forwarding cannot supply data that has not arrived. Hold for one cycle while memory finishes; then forward eleven into execute and let the addition continue.

Instruction six compares two elevens and branches to instruction nine. Before that decision, fetch has continued down the original path. Cross out seven and eight. They were fetched, but must never write a register or memory. Fetch restarts at the target. The two empty positions are the cost of this taken branch.

Run the whole program again and check the results. Both schedules finish the same eight useful instructions, with identical registers and memory. The pipeline takes fifteen cycles: eight instructions, four for filling and draining, one data stall, and two branch bubbles. Sequential execution takes forty. Scheduling changes the finish time while preserving the answer.

Polarization describes the field direction. The wave is not a winding path taken by light; its motion is greatly slowed.

Now the source is unpolarized. Watch the field in the circular view: it no longer stays on one axis. The faint lines summarize directions over time, rather than regular circular rotation. Averaged over time, perpendicular transverse directions have equal intensity. This is the light entering our first filter.

The first filter keeps the field component along its transmission axis. The transmitted light now has a fixed polarization and half the original intensity. Turn the filter: the outgoing axis turns too, but fifty percent remains. That half-intensity rule comes from unpolarized input; it is not a rule for every source.

Add a second filter with its axis aligned. The already polarized light passes through. As the final axis turns, the surviving field projection gets shorter. Intensity follows the square of that amplitude, giving the cosine-squared curve. At sixty degrees, this filter transmits one quarter of the light arriving at it.

Keep turning until the axes are perpendicular. The projection onto the final axis reaches zero, and the screen goes dark. Light still exists between the filters; it is the output after the last one that vanishes. These are ideal crossed polarizers. Real filters generally let a little light leak through.

Leave the outer filters crossed. Add a middle filter, initially parallel to the first, and turn it toward forty-five degrees. Light returns. The middle filter leaves a diagonal projection, changing the field that reaches the final filter. Two forty-five-degree projections let one eighth of the original intensity continue forward.

Account for the same input energy. The first filter absorbs half, the middle absorbs a quarter of the original total, and the final filter absorbs an eighth. Another eighth passes through. Intensity decreases at every filter. Adding the middle filter changes what reaches the last one; it supplies no energy.

Turn only the middle filter. Parallel to the first, it leaves light that the last filter blocks. Parallel to the last, it blocks the light earlier. Between those endpoints, forty-five degrees maximizes the product of both projections. Pause here, then try the dial and connect each brightness change to the field direction.

Gradually reduce the reaction torque available at the left tire. Equal side torques mean the right side is limited too. The full input request can no longer be accepted, so the diagram separates the request from transmitted torque. This explains a traction limitation; it does not calculate the later acceleration or wheel-slip speed.

Return to the connected gears. The carrier provides the average speed; pinion spin permits a difference between the sides. Turn radius determines the difference needed for rolling, while available reaction torque is a separate question. cues.text: Look at the lower coil first. The receiver circuit is open while the transmitter establishes alternating current. Follow its eight continuous turns: an insulated crossover brings out the inner end. There is no hidden wire to the upper coil. The waveform keeps reversing, creating the changing magnetic excitation.

Follow the blue flux-linkage curve, then the induced-voltage curve. At a linkage maximum, its rate of change is zero, so voltage passes through zero. A quarter-cycle later, linkage changes fastest and voltage reaches its peak. An open receiver can have induced voltage without delivering load current.

Watch the little switch beside the receiver capacitor. When it closes, current can flow through the resistive load and delivered power rises from zero. The transmitter current changes too: mutual inductance reflects the receiver load back into its circuit. Our numerical model ends at this AC resistor, before rectification or a battery.

Bring the upper coil closer while keeping the centers aligned. Mutual inductance rises and the load receives more power in this operating range. The coupling relation is a declared teaching approximation, not a measured phone-charger curve. Frequency and load still matter, so distance alone cannot predict every resonant link.

Now move sideways without changing the vertical gap. In the top view, the two winding patterns move out of alignment. Coupling and received power fall. Notice that transmitter current can remain substantial. A large current does not guarantee useful delivery; power can instead be dissipated in resistance on the sending side.

Keep the coils still and raise the drive frequency toward their tuning point. Capacitive and inductive reactance increasingly cancel, changing current and received power. The curve comes from the same circuit solution. The marked self-resonance is a coil-and-capacitor condition; it is not automatically the maximum-power frequency for every coupled load.

The dark sheets are ferrite, helping provide a magnetic return path. Compare steady operation with and without them. Flux still forms closed paths without ferrite, but more of the path lies in air. The model assigns lower inductance and mutual coupling. With unchanged capacitors, the tuning point shifts and delivered power changes.

Finally, increase both winding resistances while keeping the other conditions fixed. The power ribbon redistributes: less reaches the load and copper losses take a larger share. Every portion still sums to source input. Resonance can magnify voltage or circulating current, but it cannot create energy. A real battery charger adds further losses.

cues.text: Look into the cutaway. The magnet and steel circuit stay fixed, while the copper winding sits on a bobbin joined to the cone. A small applied voltage starts the moving assembly. Travel is enlarged so you can follow it, but all its connected parts use the same physical displacement.

Move closer to the narrow gap. The blue arrow marks the permanent field, which does not reverse with the signal. Now the current changes sign, and the axial force reverses with it. Force equals current times the force factor. The coil moves with clearance; it does not slide against the pole.

Follow the joint between the coil and cone. They move together while the surround and spider flex between moving and fixed endpoints. Below, spring force points opposite displacement: move farther from equilibrium and the restoring force grows. The flexible leads bend too, keeping the electrical connection intact throughout the motion.

Set the applied voltage to zero but leave the circuit closed. Stored spring energy keeps the cone moving. Watch velocity and back EMF together: a moving coil generates voltage and affects current in the closed circuit. Current can drive motion, and motion can drive current. Both directions share the same force factor.

Return to sinusoidal drive and follow power through a cycle. Resistance and mechanical damping dissipate energy; the remainder changes magnetic, kinetic and spring energy. A negative storage rate means earlier energy is being released. Electrical and mechanical conversion powers are equal, so coupling the two domains cannot create extra energy.

Keep peak voltage fixed and compare frequencies one by one. Each point is a settled sinusoidal response, measured at maximum excursion, rather than a rapid sweep. Mass, stiffness, damping and inductance all shape the curve. It describes how far the cone moves; it is not the sound-pressure level at a listener.

Now keep frequency fixed and compare different mechanical damping values. More damping lowers excursion, and electrical impedance changes too because motion changes the back EMF. The coil is more than a fixed resistor. These are settled comparisons between settings, not a freely moving system whose damping changes without outside intervention.

Follow the gold air point. It oscillates near its own rest position while the compression pattern travels outward. The boundary follows the cone, and neighboring positions respond after a propagation delay. This is a one-dimensional plane-wave illustration with enlarged motion, not a prediction of the real speaker’s spatial sound-pressure field.

现在把交流周期放慢。先看穿过蓝色回路的外加磁通，再看下面的感应电动势。磁通到达峰值时，它的变化率暂时为零；变化最快时，感应电动势最大。锅底电流还受到自身电阻和电感影响，所以不能把电流直接画成磁通的复制品。
把目光移到锅底表面，再沿曲线向金属内部看。现在只提高频率，虚线标出的集肤深度逐渐变小，电损耗更集中在靠近线圈的一面。颜色表示周期平均的电阻发热，不是金属发光。这里省略了磁滞损耗，也没有把颜色当成真实温度分布。
保持线圈电流和频率不变，只把同一口锅抬高一点。线圈和锅底之间的互感减小，蓝色回路获得的感应电动势随之减弱，电损耗也下降。这个比较没有偷偷增大电流来补偿距离。玻璃不需要先烧热，电磁耦合本身就能把能量送到锅底。
依次换成磁性钢、非磁性不锈钢和铝，几何与驱动条件都保持不变。留意电损耗并不只由导电性决定，集肤和回路电感也参与其中。铝的结果不是零。专门设计的设备可以加热非磁性金属；某口锅是否适配某台电磁炉，仍要看具体设备的设计。
这里用放慢的四秒包络说明功率调节。棕色区间内保持原来的交流驱动，空白区间暂停输入。看当前功率在开启和停止之间切换，而时间平均值更低。锅没有跟着每一次停顿立刻冷下来，因为热量已经存进了金属。真实炉具也可能采用别的调节方式。
回到持续输入，把热过程加速。棕色曲线代表锅体，蓝色代表玻璃。起初只有锅体直接得到电损耗产生的热；有了温差，热量才通过接触流向玻璃。同时，两者都在向室温环境散热。下面储存的热量来自同一个能量收支，并不是另加的一段装饰动画。
现在停止电输入。锅体开始降温，但玻璃曲线还可能继续向上走一小段：较热的锅仍在把余热传给它。这并不违反能量守恒，两个物体的总储热一直在减少。把电功率关掉和把温度降到室温，是两件不同的事；最后留下的是逐渐散去的热。

cues.text: Follow the copper conductor. It leaves the source, winds into a flat spiral, then returns underneath. Glass separates it from the pan; current does not cross the glass. The blue ring represents a second closed current path inside the pan. Its transparent front is a cutaway, not a physical break.

Slow the electrical cycle and track the applied flux through the blue loop. At a flux peak, its rate of change is momentarily zero. When flux changes fastest, induced voltage is largest. The pan current also depends on its resistance and inductance, so it is not simply a copy of flux.

Look inward from the pan surface nearest the coil. Increase frequency and the marked skin depth becomes smaller: more of the electrical loss lies near that face. Color shows cycle-average resistive heating, not glowing metal. Hysteresis loss is omitted here, and this depth profile is not a predicted temperature map.

Keep coil current and frequency fixed, then lift the same pan. Mutual coupling falls, so the induced voltage and pan heating fall too. The source is not increasing current to compensate for distance. Energy reaches the pan through electromagnetic coupling; the glass does not have to heat up first.

Compare magnetic steel, nonmagnetic stainless steel and aluminum without changing geometry or drive. Conductivity alone does not decide the heating; skin effect and loop inductance matter too. Aluminum still gives a nonzero result. Specially designed cooktops can heat nonmagnetic metals, while actual pan compatibility depends on the particular appliance.

The four-second teaching envelope turns the same AC drive on for each brown interval, then pauses it. Current heating switches between its on value and zero, while average power is lower. The pan does not become cold at every pause because metal stores heat. Real appliances may regulate power differently.

Return to continuous input and accelerate thermal time. Brown follows the pan; blue follows the glass. Initially, electrical loss heats only the pan. A temperature difference then drives contact heat into the glass, while both lose heat to the room. Their stored heat comes from that same energy balance.

Stop electrical input. The pan cools, yet the glass may keep warming briefly because the hotter pan still transfers stored heat into it. That does not create energy: their total stored heat keeps falling. Switching electrical power off and returning everything to room temperature happen on very different time scales.

cues.text: 先别跟着针尖跑，看看两种颜色。铜红色的上线从线轴出发，经过挑线杆，再穿过靠近针尖的针眼。青绿色的底线藏在布下面，由梭心供给。现在针向下走，把上线带进织物。针本身不会打结，真正让两根线相扣的动作，还在下面。
把目光停在针眼后面。针先降到最低处，随后开始回升。真实缝纫中，线与布料之间的作用让这段上线暂时留下，形成一个小环。针背上的凹槽给梭尖留出接近的位置。这里把柔软线的形状放慢展示；线环的大小并不是只由针的位置决定。
金色梭尖过来了。它接近的是针后的线环，不是针尖正下方。针已经回升，梭尖从针眼上方掠过，接住铜红色上线。看两者的相对位置：既要赶上这个线环，也必须给金属机针留出间隙。整个过程都由同一个周期位置决定，并非两个各自转动的动画。
现在沿着铜红色线环转过去。梭尖携带线环向下走，两条线腿分别经过梭心套的前面和后面。中间这只套没有跟着旋梭转；里面的梭心负责提供底线。关键不是让上线穿过梭心，而是把整个上线环带到它的周围，使底线进入这个环的包围之中。
线环已经绕过梭心套，现在轮到脱环。后侧的线腿沿外缘移到前侧，留出接下来收紧的通路。注意上线没有突然从套里面穿出来，也没有换成另一条线。旋梭仍然继续转动，但这一针的线环已不再跟随梭尖；在这个机构中，一次针周期对应旋梭两圈。
回到上方，看挑线杆抬起来。它把上线往回收，刚才包住梭心套的大环便越来越小。下面留下的不是一个独立绳结，而是上线绕住底线的交锁。这里把布料剖开，好看清两种颜色如何相扣。实际交锁落在什么深度，还取决于上下线张力与织物。
这一针收好了，织物才能送往下一针的位置。看送布牙：它从针板下面升起，贴住布底，再把布向后推进。此时机针已经完全离开织物。送布牙随后下降，在板下返回。本模型把送布放在收紧之后，便于分别看清；真实机构中的动作区间可能有部分重叠。
最后比较两块分别计算的样布。两边始终处在相同的周期位置，机针与旋梭的关系完全相同；只有每针送布的距离不同。下方样布的线迹跨度更大，但上线与底线仍然在布内相扣。想复查刚才的一针，可以进入探索，慢慢移动周期滑块，把接环、脱环和收紧分别停下来。

cues.text: Follow the two colours before following the needle. The copper thread comes from the spool, passes through the take-up lever, and enters the eye near the needle tip. The teal thread has a separate supply below the cloth. As the needle descends, it carries the upper thread down. The interlocking action is still to come.

Watch just behind the eye. The needle reaches its lowest position and begins to rise. In real sewing, interaction between thread and fabric leaves a small loop available for pickup. The scarf provides room for the hook point. Our slow view prescribes the flexible loop shape; needle position alone does not determine every detail of that shape.

Here comes the gold hook point. It approaches the loop behind the needle, passing above the eye after the needle has begun rising. The captured copper strand follows the hook throat. Timing matters because the loop must be available while the metal parts remain separated. Needle and hook positions here come from the same cycle coordinate.

Follow the copper loop around the case. Its two legs take different routes, one behind the case and one in front. The case stays in place while the outer hook rotates. The bobbin supplies the teal thread inside it. The upper thread never needs to pass through the bobbin: its loop travels around the whole assembly.

The loop now leaves the hook. Its rear leg moves around the outside rim toward the front, opening a route for tightening. Keep following the same copper strand: it does not jump through the case or get replaced. The hook continues rotating without carrying this loop. This illustrated mechanism uses two hook revolutions for each needle cycle.

Look up at the take-up lever as it rises. Drawing the upper thread back reduces the large loop below. What remains is an interlock with the lower thread, rather than a separate knot tied by the needle. The fabric section exposes the two colours. In a real seam, thread tensions and material affect where that interlock settles.

The stitch is tightened, and the cloth can move to its next position. The feed dogs rise from below the plate, contact the underside, and advance the fabric while the needle is clear. They then drop and return underneath. We separate tightening and feeding for this explanation; actual mechanisms can overlap parts of those actions.

Compare these two separately reconstructed samples. Both follow the same cycle position and the same needle-to-hook timing. Only the feed distance differs. The lower sample has wider stitch spacing, but each interlock still joins the same two threads. In exploration, move through a single cycle to stop at pickup, release, or tightening and trace the route again.

cues.text: 先沿着亮起的线路走一遍。这个半周，交流端 A 的电压较高，电流经过左上的 D 一，走到负载上端，再从负载下端经过右下的 D 四返回。只有这两只二极管导通。请记住负载里的方向：从上往下。下一段交流会反转，看看它会不会跟着改变。
现在 B 端变成较高的一端。刚才那两只二极管截止，电流改走右上的 D 二，仍然先到负载上端，再经过左下的 D 三返回。桥里的路径换了，但负载里的方向没有换。四只二极管的连接方式，正是让两个相反的半周都得到同一种输出极性的原因。
把两个半周放回一张波形图。橙色交流电压一上一下，绿色输出却始终留在零线以上。交流每完成一个周期，输出就出现两个脉冲，所以五十赫兹输入对应一百赫兹脉动。不过，绿色曲线仍然反复下落。方向统一了，并不意味着输出电压已经足够平稳。
现在在负载两端接入一只空电容，从零电荷开始。源电压升高到足够推动二极管电流时，桥才给电容充电。请看紫色支路和电压曲线，储存的电荷一点点增加，没有瞬间跳到峰值。接下来，即使交流源开始回落，电容也已经有能量可以继续供给负载。
留意虚线表示的门槛：电容电压，再加上两只二极管的压降。源电压的幅值超过它，桥电流才出现。离开这段窗口，四只二极管都截止，电容通过负载缓慢放电，直到下一次补充。整流桥不是整个半周都在给电容送电，电容也没有把电流倒灌回交流源。
保持电源和负载不变，把电容从二百二十微法换成两千二百微法。两张曲线使用相同的电压刻度，所以现在看到的起伏缩小，是真正的纹波下降。较大的电容每失去同样一小份电荷，电压下降得更少；而补充电荷的工作，仍要通过桥里的导通窗口完成。
先把负载电阻从二百欧降到五十欧。负载索取更多电流，两次补充之间，电容电压下落得更明显。然后保持这个较重的负载，把交流频率从五十赫兹改成一百赫兹。同一个二十毫秒窗口里，充电机会变多了，电容来不及下降那么多，纹波因此又变小。
最后，把空电容接入的时刻移到交流峰值。电容起初没有电压，源和它之间的差值很大，于是出现很高的充电电流。现在增大图中的源电阻，峰值明显受限，电容充电也更慢。这里展示的是低压桥式整流模型；实际电源还需要考虑器件额定值、保护和更多寄生效应。

cues.text: Follow the illuminated path. In this half-cycle, terminal A is higher. Current goes through the upper-left diode, D one, into the top of the load. It returns through the lower-right diode, D four. Only that pair conducts. Remember the downward direction through the load; we will check it again after the AC reverses.

Now terminal B is higher. The previous pair blocks, and current takes the upper-right diode, D two, to the top of the load. It returns through the lower-left diode, D three. The bridge route has changed, but load current still points downward. That arrangement gives both opposite half-cycles the same output polarity.

Put both halves on one time axis. The orange source voltage swings above and below zero, while the green output stays nonnegative. One AC cycle produces two output pulses: fifty hertz in, one hundred hertz of pulsation. But the green trace still falls between peaks. Rectifying the direction has not yet smoothed the voltage.

Connect an initially empty capacitor across the load. Once the source is high enough to drive the diodes, current charges it. Watch the violet branch and the voltage trace: stored charge builds continuously, rather than jumping straight to the peak. When the source falls again, the capacitor already has energy to supply the load.

The dashed line marks the capacitor voltage plus two diode drops. Bridge current appears only when the source magnitude exceeds it. Outside that window, all four diodes block and the capacitor discharges through the load until the next recharge. It neither receives current throughout the whole half-cycle nor sends stored charge backward into the source.

Keep the source and load settings, and increase capacitance from two hundred twenty to twenty-two hundred microfarads. Both traces use the same voltage scale, so the smaller variation is a real reduction in ripple. A larger capacitor loses less voltage for a given amount of charge removed. Recharging still happens through the bridge conduction windows.

First reduce the load from two hundred ohms to fifty. It draws more current, so capacitor voltage falls farther between recharges. Keep that heavier load and double AC frequency from fifty to one hundred hertz. In the same twenty-millisecond window, recharge opportunities arrive more often. The capacitor has less time to discharge, and ripple decreases.

Finally connect the empty capacitor at the AC crest. Its initial voltage is zero, leaving a large voltage difference that drives an inrush pulse. Increase the modeled source resistance: the peak falls, and charging becomes slower. This is a low-voltage teaching model; real supplies also require device ratings, protection, and parasitic effects beyond this calculation.

cues.text: 先看一格完全静止、温度均匀的流体。下板保持暖，上板保持冷，颜色开始从两端向里面展开。亮点还没有移动，但热已经在传递，这叫传导。现在没有任何横向扰动，计算不会偷偷加一条循环路线。
重新开始，这次先放好一个导热温度层，再加入很小的横向温度差。它是明确写入初态的扰动，不是随机晃动。留意中间和两侧，细小的速度箭头逐渐出现。温度影响浮力，流动又改变温度，两个计算从这里相互接上。
让同一组计算继续。下方的暖色伸向上方，冷色流体也找到了向下的通道。并不是所有暖色点都只能往上走，局部速度由整个不可压缩流场决定。这里看到的暖流，是温度输运和浮力持续相互作用的结果。
跟住这个亮点，再看紫色染料怎样被拉开。格子没有出口，哪里向上，就必须有别处回流。亮点的身份一直保留，但它经过的局部温度会改变。圆圈不是预先画好的；位置和染料都从实际算出的速度场一步步推进。
用相同初态和温差再做一次，只把浮力耦合关掉。没有驱动循环，热仍然能够传导。对照中间截面的携热读数：有流动时，流体搬走了热；没有流动时，这一项为零。温度颜色变化，并不自动意味着发生了对流。
现在保留浮力，只交换冷热板的位置。同一个小扰动，从下面加热时能长大，从上面加热时却逐渐衰减。上方暖、下方冷的分层比较稳定。热没有被封住，仍主要靠传导向下走，只是不再发展出刚才那样的循环。
回到已经建立循环的格子，把两块板都调到中间温度。注意，亮点没有立刻停住，原来的温度差也没有瞬间消失。随着热扩散和动量耗散继续，颜色逐渐均匀，动能读数降低。撤去外加温差，与抹掉已有流动，是两件不同的事。
最后把计算单元显露出来，再用更细的网格比较同一时刻。两组都出现对流，携热数值却不完全相同。迎风格式还带有额外的数值耗散，所以这里不报一个所谓精确的临界阈值。画面解释这组理想边界里的温度与流动，不替代真实三维实验。

cues.text: Begin with motionless fluid at one uniform temperature. Hold the lower plate warm and the upper plate cool. Color spreads inward from both ends. The tracers have not moved, yet heat is already traveling by conduction. There is no sideways disturbance in this setup, and no circulation path hidden in the animation.

Restart from a conductive temperature layer, this time with a small sideways temperature disturbance. It is prescribed in the initial state, not random movement. Watch the center and the sides as small velocity arrows appear. Temperature changes buoyancy, and the resulting flow carries temperature. The two parts of the calculation are now coupled.

Continue the same calculation. Warm colors extend upward while cooler fluid finds a downward route. A warm-colored point is not required to move upward at every instant: its local velocity belongs to the whole incompressible flow. The developing current comes from temperature transport and buoyancy continually affecting one another.

Follow the bright tracer and watch the purple dye stretch through the cell. There is no outlet, so rising fluid needs a return path elsewhere. The tracer keeps its identity, but the temperature at its position can change. Neither its route nor the dye pattern is drawn in advance; both follow the computed velocity.

Repeat with the same initial temperature and plate difference, but disable buoyancy coupling. Nothing drives circulation, yet conduction still transfers heat. Compare the advective heat readings across the middle of the cell. Moving fluid carries heat; the motionless case has zero advective transport. A changing temperature image alone does not prove that convection is happening.

Keep buoyancy active and exchange the warm and cool plates. The same small disturbance grows when heated from below but decays when heated from above. Warm fluid above cool fluid makes a stable arrangement here. Heat is not trapped: it still travels mainly downward by conduction, without developing the earlier circulation.

Return to an established circulation and set both plates to the middle temperature. The tracers do not stop immediately, and stored temperature differences remain for a while. As diffusion and momentum dissipation continue, the colors even out and kinetic energy falls. Removing the imposed temperature contrast does not instantly erase the existing flow.

Reveal the computational cells and compare a finer grid at the same elapsed time. Both produce convection, but their heat-transport readings differ. The upwind scheme also adds numerical dissipation, so we do not report a supposedly precise onset threshold. This window explains coupled heat and flow under idealized boundaries; it does not replace a real three-dimensional experiment.

cues.text: 先别急着数电流，先看每个光子的能量。这颗低能光子跨不过硅的带隙，继续穿过去。能量足够的光子，吸收后可以激发一对电子和空穴。注意能量更高的那一颗：多出来的能量变成热，并没有在这里变出第二对电荷。
现在切开电池，跟住一个确定被吸收的光子。电子和空穴在同一处出现，电荷没有凭空增加。电子先扩散到结区，再被那里的电场推向上方；空穴向下方的接点移动。注意，电场只标在薄薄的结区里，不是整块硅都在被同样地推动。
电子到了前接点，路还没有结束。沿导线往右，它经过负载，最后回到背面的接点。空穴没有钻进金属导线，而是在电池这一侧等待复合。这里慢放的是一对电荷的完整路径；持续照明时，许多这样的过程共同维持电流，标记的数量并不代表安培数。
把负载电阻慢慢增大，看棕色直线转动。它和蓝色电池曲线的交点，才是电路实际采用的电压和电流。浅色矩形的面积表示两者相乘，也就是输出功率。交点经过空心标记附近时，面积最大；继续增大电阻，电压还在升，功率却已经下降。

Turn the notice over and inspect its construction. Eleven times seventeen gives the public modulus. The least common multiple of ten and sixteen is eighty. Choose seven as the public exponent. Euclid’s algorithm gives twenty-three for the return trip: their product leaves remainder one modulo eighty. That is a modular inverse, not an ordinary fraction.

Our message is an integer between zero and one hundred eighty-six. Try just one square. Forty-two squared is one thousand seven hundred and sixty-four. Remove nine whole copies of the modulus, and eighty-one remains. That remainder is what mod means. We can reduce after every multiplication, keeping the arithmetic small without changing its eventual answer.

We do not need to build the enormous seventh power first. Along the top, successive squares give powers one, two and four. Those exponents add to seven, so all three terms are selected. The recipient starts with fifteen and uses the private exponent, twenty-three. The same arithmetic now selects powers one, two, four and sixteen. Watch the eighth-power column carefully. Its remainder is computed but never multiplied into the accumulator, which stays at ninety-three. The final selected term brings back forty-two, the original message.

Both prime remainders return correctly, identifying the original integer. We also check all one hundred eighty-seven possible inputs for this key.

A successful return trip does not guarantee secrecy. Send forty-two twice and both ciphertexts are fifteen. An observer has the public key too, and can encrypt candidate messages starting at zero. There: the forty-two row matches. This small message space, with no randomized padding, lets a public calculation reveal what the envelope contained.

In a hybrid design it protects a random symmetric key, while authenticated symmetric encryption protects the content. This is only an architecture diagram. cues.text: 先看三个位置受到的月球引力。近侧比地心强一点，远侧比地心弱一点，但方向都大致朝向月球。金色观测点从近侧走向远侧，当地的加速度也跟着改变。地心不是钉在原地的支点；理解潮汐，要比较这些加速度之间的差，而不是只看一个向月球的箭头。
现在跟地心一起自由下落。在每一个位置，都减去同一份地心加速度。远侧受月球牵引较弱，剩下的相对加速度背向月球；近侧受牵引较强，剩下的相对加速度朝向月球。注意两端都在相对远离地心，不需要再给远侧加上一只神秘的推手。
想象一颗刚性的球形地球，表面全是能够立即达到平衡的海洋。同一个潮汐势，决定这张理想海面的高度。现在慢慢放大微小的形变，近侧和远侧都隆起，横向的海面降低。这是形变比例尺在变化，不是海水流动的录像；高度曲线的米数仍是模型算出的高度。
在受控比较中，让月球靠近一些。整体引力随距离的平方变化，主导潮汐项却随距离的三次方变化，所以实线比虚线上升更快。地球的大小没有改变，改变的是引力跨越这个大小时的差异。这里的距离滑块是思想实验，不是月球真实运行日期的进度条。
先保留月球，再逐渐把太阳的潮汐项加进来。太阳对地球的整体引力很强，却因为距离遥远，跨越地球的引力差没有那么大。在这组参考距离下，太阳的主导潮汐强度约为月球的零点四六倍。两者同向时，平衡海面的形变叠加，潮差也随之增大。
接下来转动太阳方向，保持两项的强度不变。日月形成直角时，赤道上的平衡潮差缩小，对应小潮的理想情形。继续转到另一端，三者重新排成直线，潮差又增大。月球与太阳在同一侧或相对两侧，都能增强大潮；不能只用两根整体引力箭头相加来判断。
把月球方向固定，让赤道上的一个观测位置转过一圈。金色标记会依次经过这张理想海面的两个高处，曲线记录的也是同一个位置的计算高度。这里追踪的是地球上的位置，不是一团绕圈跑的海水。横轴用相对转角表示，不能把它直接读成某个港口的潮汐时刻。
换到四十五度纬圈，再让月球偏离赤道，两次理想高值开始不一样。随后把观测点移向更高纬度，这个例子最后只剩一个峰值。真实海洋还受到海盆形状、自转、摩擦与共振影响。所以，一天两次高潮并不是所有海岸的统一规则，这张平衡图也不能给出当地的潮高预报。

cues.text: Look at the accelerations across Earth. The near side is pulled a little more strongly than the center; the far side a little less. All still accelerate toward the Moon. As the gold point crosses the globe, its acceleration changes. Earth’s center is not fixed in place. That small difference is what matters.

Now fall with Earth’s center. Subtract the same center acceleration at every location. The far-side remainder points away from the Moon because the lunar pull there is weaker. On the near side, the remainder points toward the Moon. Both ends stretch away from the center. No separate far-side push is needed.

Imagine a rigid spherical Earth covered by an ocean that settles instantly. The same tidal potential sets its equilibrium surface. We gradually magnify the tiny height differences, not water motion. Both ends rise while the crosswise surface falls. The metre values remain the physical model results, even while the picture makes the deformation enormous.

Bring the Moon closer in this controlled comparison. Bulk attraction grows with inverse distance squared, but the leading tidal term grows with inverse distance cubed. The solid curve rises faster than the dashed one. Earth’s size stays fixed; gravity varies more across it. This is a thought experiment, not an orbital calendar.

Keep the Moon’s contribution, then gradually add the Sun’s. The Sun exerts strong bulk attraction, but its enormous distance limits the variation across Earth. At these reference distances, its leading tidal strength is about forty-six percent of the Moon’s. When their directions align, the equilibrium deformations reinforce each other and the range grows.

Turn the Sun’s direction while keeping both strengths fixed. At a right angle, the equatorial equilibrium range shrinks: the ideal neap-tide case. Continue to the opposite alignment and the range grows again. Both same-side and opposite-side alignments reinforce spring tides. Adding two bulk-gravity arrows alone would miss what the tidal field is doing.

Hold the Moon’s direction fixed and turn a marked site around the equator. It crosses two high parts of this equilibrium surface. The plotted height comes from that same site calculation. The marker follows a location on Earth, not a parcel of water. Our horizontal axis is an angle, not a local tide timetable.

Start at forty-five degrees latitude and move the Moon north of the equator. The two ideal peaks become unequal. Now move the observer farther north: this example ends with one peak. Real oceans also involve basin shape, rotation, friction and resonance. Neither these heights nor two daily high tides are universal coastal rules.

cues.text: 看这台挖掘机挖起一斗土：铲斗先收拢，斗杆往回收，动臂再把整条臂抬起来。注意，每一段黄色的钢臂长度都没有变，真正在伸长和缩短的，是连在关节之间的三支油缸。一支油缸伸出去，一个关节就转过去。力，就是从这几根缸里进来的。
我们把一支动臂缸沿轴线剖开。里面是一根活塞杆，杆的末端是活塞，活塞把缸筒隔成两个腔：靠底部的无杆腔，和套着杆的有杆腔。泵把油送进无杆腔，油越积越多，活塞只能往外走，活塞杆就把动臂顶了起来。另一腔里的油同时被挤出去，沿回油管流回油箱。
油从哪里来？发动机带动泵，把油箱里的油源源不断送出来；泵只负责流量。油经过主控制阀，阀芯决定它去哪一支缸的哪个腔。进无杆腔的油顶出活塞，有杆腔挤出的油再经阀回到油箱。油没有被消耗，只是在这条闭合油路里循环。
轻轻拉杆，油缸和泵连通了。看压力表：斗里三百公斤时六点五兆帕，加到一千八百公斤，升到九点五。压力不是泵定的，是载荷定的。帕斯卡原理说，连通的油液里压力处处相等：泵里直径两厘米的小活塞和动臂缸直径十二厘米的大活塞，顶着同样的压力，面积大三十六倍，推力也大三十六倍。这就是液压以小博大的道理。
手柄并不直接连着油缸，它推的是阀芯。杆拉得少，阀口开得小，进油少：每分钟四十升，活塞每秒走三厘米，动臂慢慢抬。杆拉到底，阀口全开，一百升，七厘米多，动臂明显快了。面积和压力都几乎没变，变的只是每秒进来多少油。右手杆管动臂和铲斗，左手杆管斗杆和回转。
换到侧面看。油缸的推力沿着它自己的轴线，而动臂绕着支点转。从支点到这条作用线的垂直距离，就是力臂 d。动臂抬升时，斗里的土离支点的水平距离变短，重力矩变小；同时这条橙色的力臂也在变短。两者一起决定所需压力：动臂低时八点六兆帕，抬到最高七点八。设计师要做的，就是在整个动作范围里，把力臂安排得够用。
最后一段传动最巧。铲斗缸装在斗杆背上，它的活塞杆并不直接推铲斗，而是推在一个接点上：接点一头连着摇臂，摇臂铰在斗杆上；另一头连着连杆，连杆铰在铲斗的耳板上。四个铰点组成一个四连杆。看，活塞杆伸出，接点被推向斗尖，连杆把铲斗耳板往前顶，铲斗就绕着铲斗销卷了进来。杆走直线，斗齿走的是一段圆弧。
如果斗齿卡在一块搬不动的石头下面呢？操作手继续推举升，泵继续送油，可是活塞走不动，压力一路上升。到三十七点三兆帕，主溢流阀打开，多余的油从溢流阀直接回油箱：泵还在转，动臂却不会再往上。这是液压系统保护自己的方式。松开手柄，阀口关闭，油被封在缸里，压力回落到只承担自重，动臂就停在原地。

cues.text: Watch the excavator take a bucket of earth: the bucket curls, the stick draws in, and the boom lifts the whole arm. Notice that none of the yellow steel members changes length. What extends and retracts are the three cylinders bridging the joints. One cylinder pushes out, one joint turns. This is where the force comes in.

Let's cut one boom cylinder open along its axis. Inside is a rod, and at the end of the rod a piston that divides the barrel into two chambers: the cap end at the base, and the rod end around the rod. The pump sends oil into the cap end. As oil accumulates, the piston has nowhere to go but outward, and the rod lifts the boom. Oil in the other chamber is squeezed out and returns to the tank.

Where does the oil come from? The engine drives a pump that draws oil from the tank and keeps sending it out; the pump only provides flow. The oil passes through the main control valve, where a spool decides which cylinder and which chamber it goes to. Oil entering the cap end pushes the piston out, and oil squeezed from the rod end returns through the valve to the tank. Nothing is used up; the oil circulates in one closed loop.

Pull the lever a little and the cylinder is connected to the pump. Watch the gauge: three hundred kilograms in the bucket reads six and a half megapascals; add earth up to eighteen hundred and it climbs to nine and a half. The pump doesn't set the pressure; the load does. Pascal's principle says the connected oil carries one pressure everywhere. A pump piston two centimetres across and the boom piston twelve centimetres across feel the same pressure, and thirty-six times the area means thirty-six times the force. That is how hydraulics turns a small push into a large one.

The lever isn't linked to the cylinder; it moves the spool. Pull a little and the port opens a little, so little oil gets through: forty litres a minute, the piston creeps at three centimetres a second, the boom rises slowly. Pull all the way and the port is wide open: a hundred litres, over seven centimetres a second, and the boom is clearly quicker. Area and pressure barely change; what changes is how much oil arrives each second. The right lever runs the boom and bucket, the left lever the stick and swing.

Switch to the side. A cylinder pushes along its own axis, while the boom turns about its foot pin. The perpendicular distance from that pin to the line of action is the lever arm, d. As the boom rises, the earth moves closer to the pivot, so the gravity moment shrinks, and the orange lever arm shortens too. Together they set the required pressure: eight point six megapascals with the boom low, seven point eight at the top. A designer's job is to keep that lever arm generous through the whole range.

The last link in the chain is the cleverest. The bucket cylinder sits on the back of the stick, and its rod doesn't push the bucket directly. It pushes a joint: on one side the rocker, pinned to the stick; on the other the link, pinned to the bucket's ears. Four pins make a four-bar linkage. Watch: as the rod extends, the joint is pushed toward the tip, the link drives the bucket ear forward, and the bucket curls in about its pin. The rod moves in a straight line; the teeth sweep an arc.

What if the teeth are caught under a boulder that won't move? The operator keeps calling for lift, the pump keeps delivering, but the piston can't advance, so pressure climbs. At thirty-seven point three megapascals the main relief valve opens and the surplus oil goes straight back to the tank. The pump is still turning, but the boom will not rise. That is how a hydraulic system protects itself. Release the lever, the valve closes, the oil is trapped, pressure falls back to the weight alone, and the boom simply stays where it is.
